candidates.title: Pet Naming and Personality Customization Split
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection screen into a split view featuring live preview animations alongside personality selection cards and name input fields.
candidates.why: Adoption drops 32.1% of users with an 89s median time, showing friction during pet customization.

guard.reason: 'pick_friend.replace.pet_choices[2]': a name_input cannot do the pet_choices job (use ['animation', 'button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Controls Sandbox Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new interactive sandbox screen right before finishing onboarding where users practice hiding, moving, and chatting with their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Finish step drops 35.2% of users and support emails show post-onboarding confusion regarding controlling or hiding the pet.

home_intro.headline: You are ready to play with your pet!
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop screen.

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_controls_sandbox']

candidates.title: Post-Adoption Sign-In Auth Shift
candidates.change: Move account sign-in to take place immediately after the pet adoption certificate screen so users sign in to safeguard their newly created pet.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets mention pets missing or reset after signing in, indicating sign-in before pet adoption confuses users about account binding.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in to take place after adoption certificate is explicitly allowed and retains all required steps.

candidates.score_note: High support ticket evidence; shifting auth post-adoption aligns with value-first onboarding but requires flow changes.

candidates.title: Dual-Photo Quality Preview Verification Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a photo verification flow on the photo upload screen with real-time subject cropping preview and instant quality diagnostic badges.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets report custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual results during creation.

upload_photos.headline: Upload and verify your pet photo

guard.reason: Adding photo verification components to the photo upload screen retains its core function and complies with all rules.

candidates.score_note: Targeting 32.1% adoption drop-off, but complex multi-step preview verification flow may introduce user friction.

candidates.title: Account Cloud Sync Data Safety Warning
candidates.change: Display an explicit account data protection hint on sign-in warning users to sign in with the correct existing profile to prevent pet resets.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about lost or reset pet profiles after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Make sure to sign in with your existing account to recover your existing desktop pets safely.

guard.reason: Adding an informational data safety hint to the sign-in screen is fair and within onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Simple copy/hint fix addressing 8 tickets; low impact because sign-in drop-off is relatively low (15.2%).

candidates.title: Animated Pet Desktop Spawn Loading Bar
candidates.change: Rebuild the waiting screen with a centered spotlight layout, dynamic progress bar, and estimated time display while spawning the pet.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a mean duration of 2336s and support received 3 bug reports about pets failing to show up on desktop.

guard.reason: Displaying a progress bar and time estimate during a real waiting period for pet generation is allowed under Rule 5.

candidates.score_note: Visual progress indicator directly addresses the huge 2336s mean wait time at home step, requires screen redesign.

candidates.title: Companion Path Selection Showcase Cards
candidates.change: Display structured choice cards comparing quick pre-made pet selection against custom photo generation on choose_path.
candidates.why: choose_path has a high mean duration (514s vs 8s median), indicating users get stuck or hesitant choosing a path.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Compact Desktop Overlay Controls Card
candidates.change: Switch home_intro to a compact layout featuring a visual checklist of core desktop tray icons and key shortcuts.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and multiple users wrote support asking how to hide or summon their pet.

home_welcome.text: Press Alt+P to hide/show pet anytime

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: System Tray Pet Spawning Desktop Notification
candidates.change: Enable background ready notifications and prompt users on the waiting screen when their pet is fully rendered on the desktop.
candidates.why: Waiting step drop-off and high mean time (2336s) suggest users step away while waiting and lose track of pet desktop launch.

waiting.hint: You can minimize this app. We will alert you when your pet lands on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding a ready notification prompt and background hint on the waiting screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Desktop notifications re-engage users stepping away during long 2336s spawn times; needs OS integration.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Framing Guidelines Card
candidates.change: Add photo framing requirements checklist to the photo upload screen explaining optimal pet pose and lighting.
candidates.why: Support receives 3 emails regarding custom pet generation failures and strange rendering output.

upload_photos.hint: Ensure pet face is well-lit, centered, and fully visible in the uploaded picture.

guard.reason: Adding framing guidance checklist to photo upload screen keeps its core job and abides by all rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost guidance card targeting adoption drop-off, helping users provide better pet photos.

picked: Animated Pet Desktop Spawn Loading Bar

decisions.title: Animated Pet Desktop Spawn Loading Bar
